data.text: task add --json answers {task: {id, title}} with no label, so a script that creates a task and then refers to it by KAD-N has to list again or carry the ULID. I parsed for a label, got nothing, and to see the shape created a throwaway task — now a task.created and a task.deleted in the journal for ever. The label is derived (I7), but it is derived at the moment of the answer too; returning it beside the id, marked as derived, would have saved both events. And when the throwaway was deleted, the next task took its label, KAD-75 — a label printed a minute earlier now names something else.
